name: Yanaizu (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Yanaizu town emblem in white: an outlined ring with four small squares, enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Yanaizu, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1962.

features.role: Yanaizu town emblem — an outlined ring with four small squares, enclosing a ring
